_comment: The hub settings the app's Hub page may change, and how. A change is
written to config.toml by the hub running the CLI's own `mycelium config
set <key> -` (value on stdin), so validation and the .env rendering stay
one path. `type` is how the page edits it; a `secret` is replaced or
cleared and never read back. `app_owned` keys are set by the desktop app's
own switches, which it passes at every start and which win over
config.toml, so on a desktop hub the page sends people to the app's
settings for them instead. A restart is asked for by writing
`restart_marker` in the hub's data folder and shutting down; the desktop
supervisor then starts it again with config.toml read afresh. Bound to
